svg.title: Slide numbers, markers, and background text
svg.desc: The same slide is page 12 of 40 overall and page 2 of 8 in its section. Other sections can group their markers into one bar. Large letters fill the Research panel, while the current section, Design, has a solid red background.

text.font-family: Inter,Arial,Helvetica,'Microsoft YaHei','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC',sans-serif
